welcome.text: Welcome to Smiling Critters Drawing and Coloring School! Pick a friend to draw step by step!

draw_step_1.text: Drawing Step 1! Trace along the green dot to draw the big round head!

draw_step_2.text: Drawing Step 2! Awesome! Now trace the cute ears on top of the head!

draw_step_3.text: Drawing Step 3! Let's draw the two big eyes and the cute little nose in the middle!

draw_step_4.text: Drawing Step 4! Draw a giant happy Smiling Critter grin from cheek to cheek!

draw_step_5.text: Drawing Step 5! Now trace the cozy round tummy, waving arms, and paws!

draw_step_6.text: Drawing Step 6! Last drawing step! Trace the magic necklace charm and fluffy tail!

draw_complete.text: Hooray! You finished the whole drawing! Now let's learn how to color each part step by step!

color_step_1.text: Coloring Step 1 of 7, Main Fur and Body! Scrub your brush inside the glowing lines to color the head, body, and tail!

color_step_2.text: Coloring Step 2 of 7, Inner Ears and Muzzle! Pick the soft lighter color and fill inside the ears and face patch!

color_step_3.text: Coloring Step 3 of 7, Cozy Tummy Patch! Color the round belly oval and collar band nice and neat!

color_step_4.text: Coloring Step 4 of 7, Rosy Cheeks and Smile! Brush sweet pink onto both cheeks and the happy tongue!

color_step_5.text: Coloring Step 5 of 7, Magic Necklace Charm! Color the special pendant with bright golden shine!

color_step_6.text: Coloring Step 6 of 7, Artist Shading and Eye Sparkles! Add soft shadow under the chin and bright white sparkles in the eyes!

color_step_7.text: Coloring Step 7 of 7, Background and Stickers! Color the sunny background sky and add magic sparkles!

celebrate.text: Bravo, little artist! Your Smiling Critter drawing is alive and dancing! Tap Next Friend to draw another one!

freeplay_welcome.text: Free play! Pick any color and brush you like! Every color stays neatly inside the lines!

clean_page_confirm.text: Tap again if you want a fresh new page!

clean_page_done.text: Fresh new page! Tap undo if you want your picture back!
